name: Pinnacles National Park
tagline: Pinnacles — rock spires and short cave or bench trails; one entrance.

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass; no road connects east/west inside park.
practical.transit_note: Choose one entrance and stay there.
practical.energy_note: Heat in summer; talus caves dark and uneven.
